services.name: Fresno Police Department
services.description: City police for Fresno; call the non-emergency line to reach an officer, file a report, or report a missing person inside city limits (call 911 in an emergency).

services.name: Fresno County Sheriff's Office
services.description: County sheriff for unincorporated Fresno County; call the non-emergency dispatch line for incidents outside city limits or to report a missing person in the county.

services.name: Fresno County Sheriff's Office – Missing Persons Unit
services.description: Detective bureau unit for missing person and runaway cases; report first to the agency where the person was last seen (city of Fresno (559) 621-7000, county areas (559) 600-3111).

services.name: FBI Sacramento Field Office – Fresno Resident Agency
services.description: Federal investigators for crimes on tribal land, kidnappings, and cases crossing county or state lines; the Fresno satellite office serves Fresno, Kings, Madera, Mariposa, Merced, and Tulare counties through the 24/7 field office line.

services.name: Fresno American Indian Health Project (FAIHP)
services.description: Urban Indian health program offering culturally based health, wellness, youth, and community support services for Native people in the Fresno area.
services.address: 1551 E. Shaw Ave., Suite 139, Fresno, CA 93710

services.name: Central Valley Indian Health, Inc.
services.description: Tribal health program providing medical, dental, and behavioral health care to Native American families in the Fresno/Clovis area.

services.name: Marjaree Mason Center
services.description: Fresno County's domestic violence agency with emergency safe housing, legal advocacy, and counseling; call the 24/7 hotline for help or shelter.

services.name: RCS Fresno (Rape Counseling Service of Fresno)
services.description: Free, confidential sexual assault crisis center for Fresno County with counseling, advocacy, and hospital accompaniment; the crisis line answers 24 hours a day.

services.name: James Rowland Crime Victim Assistance Center (Fresno County)
services.description: County victim advocates who help crime victims and their families with crisis intervention, court support, restitution, and California victim compensation claims at no cost.

services.name: California Indian Legal Services – Central Office
services.description: Nonprofit law firm for Native individuals and tribes; the Sacramento-based Central Office serves Fresno, Kings, Madera, Mariposa, and Merced counties by phone and appointment.

services.name: Bakersfield Police Department
services.description: City police for Bakersfield; call the non-emergency line to reach an officer or file a report, including missing person reports inside city limits (911 in an emergency).

services.name: Kern County Sheriff's Office
services.description: County sheriff for unincorporated Kern County; call the non-emergency line for incidents or missing person reports outside city limits.

services.name: FBI Sacramento Field Office – Bakersfield Resident Agency
services.description: Federal investigators for crimes on tribal land, kidnappings, and multi-jurisdiction cases; the Bakersfield satellite office serves Kern and Inyo counties through the 24/7 field office line.

services.name: Bakersfield American Indian Health Project

services.name: The Open Door Network (formerly Alliance Against Family Violence & Sexual Assault)
